definition: A function with $f(-x) = f(x)$ for every $x$ in its domain, so its graph is symmetric in the $y$-axis.
A function with $f(-x) = -f(x)$ for every $x$ in its domain, so its graph looks the same after a half-turn about the origin.
A function whose graph repeats: there is a constant $p > 0$ with $f(x + p) = f(x)$ for every $x$, and the smallest such $p$ is the period.
